hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/app/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/app/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/components/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/components/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/lib/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/lib/*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
